rules.rule_context:
BSA / OFAC Compliance Note - Sanctions Screening Prior to Release

All outbound wires, regardless of dollar amount, customer tenure, or prior transaction history, must clear the sanctions screening engine before the wire is released to the settlement rail. There is no exception for established customers, repeat wire activity, or relationship-driven urgency. The screening step is the control of record; if it has not run to completion, the wire has not cleared review.

Tara must not recommend, action, or facilitate release of any wire where the sanctions screen is queued, pending, in progress, or returned with an unresolved alert. The wire status must reflect a completed screen with a pass or an cleared disposition before release is authorized. Time-to-resolution targets do not override this requirement. If a rep asks whether to release before the screen finishes, the answer is no.
